_readme: Editorial layer for scripts/build_catalogue.py. Product facts (size, neck, weight, finishes, photos) are read from the PDF; this file adds names, categories and wording. Rules match spec cards by model, size, weight, page-title text or special process. Products are shown in this order; new models found in a future PDF are added automatically after these and listed in the build report.

products.name: The signature cylinder
products.description: A cylindrical magnetic cap assembly with matched shoulder collar. Explore polished, matte and coated finishes.

products.name: The statement sphere
products.description: A spherical magnetic cap with a rounded silhouette and coordinated shoulder collar. Available in metallic and coloured finishes.

products.name: The natural cylinder
products.description: A hardwood magnetic cap with a cylindrical profile. The catalogue lists ash, beech and black walnut wood options.

products.name: The ribbed classic
products.description: A magnetic cap assembly with a bead-rolled surface. A textured alternative to the smooth cylindrical finish.

products.name: The soft square
products.description: A square magnetic cap with rounded edges, shown in black and gold in the catalogue’s new-product presentation.
products.note: Enquire to confirm individual finish options and the matching shoulder collar.

products.name: The refined cylinder
products.description: A 30 mm cylindrical magnetic cap assembly, available with matching metallic or matte shoulder collars.

products.name: The diamond texture
products.description: A magnetic cap from the diamond-knurling section, offered in glossy black, gold and silver.

products.name: The rounded silhouette
products.description: A softly rounded magnetic cap assembly, offered in black, gold and white with glossy or matte finishes.

products.name: The extended cylinder
products.description: The elongated member of the WL100 family, with additional height and a wide selection of metallic and coloured finishes.

products.name: The tall detail
products.description: An alternative WL-series magnetic cap profile with black, silver and red options.

products.name: The compact cylinder
products.description: A compact magnetic cap assembly for FEA13 fittings. Choose from metallic, matte, coated and coffee-coloured finishes.

products.name: The clean profile
products.description: A smooth-profile KY-series cap, paired with a matching black shoulder collar.

products.name: The smooth classic
products.description: A 31 mm KY-series magnetic cap assembly in glossy or matte black.

products.name: The compact texture
products.description: A textured magnetic cap assembly for FEA13 bottle fittings, with matched metallic or coloured collars.

products.name: The broad cylinder
products.description: A broad cylindrical magnetic cap assembly in glossy black, gold and silver.
products.note: The specification page also lists a shorter 32.5 × 29.6 mm, 29 g version. Confirm the required height when enquiring.

products.name: The broad texture
products.description: A bead-rolled KY32 magnetic cap assembly, available in glossy and matte metallic finishes.

products.name: The compact statement
products.description: A textured magnetic cap with coordinated shoulder collars, including a coated white and matte coffee combination.

products.name: The balanced cylinder
products.description: A cylindrical magnetic cap assembly from the JL30 series, with matching black, gold or silver collar finishes.

products.name: The low cylinder
products.description: The lower-profile JL30 assembly, retaining the 30 mm diameter in a shorter form.

products.name: The wide silhouette
products.description: A wider 35 mm magnetic cap assembly, with polished or matte black, gold and silver options.

products.name: The tall round form
products.description: A taller cylindrical cap from the JL52 family, with black, gold and silver finishes.
products.note: The product photograph identifies this round variant as JLY52; the page heading groups it within the JL52 range.

products.name: The architectural square
products.description: An angular magnetic cap profile shown alongside the JL52 family, in glossy black, gold and coffee.
products.note: The catalogue lists the family size as 35 × 41 mm. Confirm square-profile dimensions and collar fit when enquiring.

products.name: The metallic dome
products.description: A domed electro-aluminium magnetic cap shown in glossy gold and silver.
products.note: The specification image lists a 26.5 g cap and a 3.5 g shoulder collar (30 g total). Enquire for the silver finish.

products.name: The geometric accent
products.description: A rectangular magnetic cap in glossy black with shoulder collar options in gold, black or silver.
products.note: The image lists 33 g for the cap and 3.8 g for the collar (36.8 g total). Confirm dimensions against the technical drawing.

products.name: The wooden sphere
products.description: A spherical hardwood magnetic cap with visible natural character. The catalogue lists ash, beech and black walnut options.

products.name: The wooden dome
products.description: A rounded hardwood magnetic cap in black, paired with a gold shoulder collar.
products.note: Model name follows the JLM36 label printed on the product photograph.

products.name: The wooden bowl
products.description: A broad, gently curved hardwood magnetic cap shown in black with a silver shoulder collar.

products.name: The rolled cylinder
products.description: The bead-rolling version of the JL30 cap assembly, shown in glossy black and gold.

products.name: The rolled compact
products.description: The bead-rolling version of the JL30S magnetic cap assembly.

products.name: The textured signature
products.description: A bead-rolled variation of the WL100 cap assembly, offered in glossy black and gold.

products.name: The surface collection
products.description: Brushed, sandblasted and hydrographic treatments for selected WL, KY and JL cap models. Choose a treatment and confirm the model specification.
products.note: Fitting, dimensions and weight vary by selected model. The WL50 special-finish page lists FEA15; the standard WL50 page lists FEA13. Confirm the required fitting with the supplier.

products.name: The connecting detail
products.description: Single-step and double-step shoulder collars in metallic and coloured finishes, with FEA13 and FEA15 options shown in the catalogue.
products.note: Choose the collar height and profile to suit the matching cap and bottle. See pages 38–39 for the full range.

products.name: The matched collar
products.description: JL30 shoulder collar profiles, plus multi-step and special-shaped collars for different cap assemblies.

products.name: The supporting form
products.description: Square shoulder collars and middle collars, shown alongside circular collar options in the catalogue.

products.name: The finishing system
products.description: Anodized perfume pumps in black, gold and silver, with FEA13 and FEA15 fitting options.
products.note: Contact us to confirm the pump assembly, finish, dosage and bottle compatibility.

products.name: Beyond the perfume bottle
products.description: Closures for healthcare, facial cream, essential oil and lotion packaging. The catalogue includes 45 × 12.5, 30 × 12.5 and 63.5 × 19.1 mm examples.
products.note: Specify the container and required closure dimensions in your enquiry.

products.name: The colour companion
products.description: Lipstick tubes and lipstick bundles are available for customisation, alongside the catalogue’s cosmetic closure range.
products.note: Enquire with your required dimensions, mechanism and decoration.

ignore._why: Second row on the KY32 page lists conflicting sizes; the product note mentions the 29 g version.
